firmographic.name: PostHog
firmographic.company_description: PostHog is an open-source developer product platform ("Product OS") that consolidates product analytics, session replay (web and mobile), feature flags, A/B experiments, surveys, error tracking, a managed data warehouse, a customer data platform with 120+ sources/destinations, AI observability for LLM applications, and an AI copilot into a single integrated suite. Its data layer is built on ClickHouse with high-volume services written in Rust and a proprietary Hog language running on a custom HogVM virtual machine (replacing earlier Node.js VMs); orchestration runs on Temporal and infrastructure sits on AWS across US-East-1 (Virginia) and EU-Central-1 (Frankfurt) with Cloudflare for edge/proxy and Wiz for security. The MIT-licensed core is self-hostable on Kubernetes, while advanced features and managed Cloud are sold as paid upgrades. The company targets product engineers, developers, and high-growth startups as its primary audience, with secondary positioning for HIPAA-regulated healthcare buyers and EU/privacy-conscious mid-market and enterprise customers. PostHog makes money through usage-based pay-per-event/recording/row pricing with generous free tiers (used by 98% of customers), Boost/Scale/Enterprise platform subscriptions (median annual contract value ~$54,443 per Vendr data) that unlock HIPAA BAAs, custom MSAs/DPAs, dedicated support and a 99.95% uptime SLA, and an inside-sales motion for mid-market and enterprise that runs alongside self-serve PLG signups. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, was founded in 2020 by James Hawkins and Tim Glaser, grew from 11 to over 150 employees, serves 300,000+ companies, reached $9.5 million in ARR in 2024 with 138% year-over-year growth, and achieved a $1.4 billion unicorn valuation in September 2025 via a $75 million Series E led by Peak XV Partners.
firmographic.company_description_short: PostHog is an open-source all-in-one developer platform ("Product OS") offering product analytics, session replay, feature flags, experiments, surveys, error tracking, a managed data warehouse, and a CDP, targeting product engineers, startups, and mid-market/enterprise buyers with usage-based pricing and HIPAA/GDPR-compliant Cloud and self-hosting options.

scale_indicator.description: PostHog reached unicorn status with a $1.4 billion valuation as of September 2025 with its $75M Series E round.
PostHog has raised a total of $194 million across 7 funding rounds, with its largest being the $75M Series E.
PostHog reached $9.5 million ARR in 2024 with 138% year-over-year growth.
PostHog is used by over 300,000 companies as the all-in-one analytics, experimentation, feature flag, surveys, session replay, error tracking, data warehouse, and LLM analytics platform.
PostHog's 'Product for Engineers' newsletter is read by 100,000+ founders and builders, indicating strong developer mindshare.
PostHog captured 54% of Y Combinator's Winter 2023 batch, signaling strong product-market fit in the startup developer-tools segment.
PostHog has attracted 13 investors total, comprising 10 institutional and 3 angel investors.
PostHog grew from 11 to over 150 employees over a five-year period while scaling revenue.
PostHog's CDP supports over 120 sources and destinations, plus an API and webhooks layer.
PostHog's valuation grew from $920M in June 2024 to $1.4B in September 2025, representing ~52% growth in 15 months.
PostHog Cloud is SOC 2 Type II compliant, GDPR-compliant, CCPA-compliant, participates in the EU-US/UK/Swiss Data Privacy Frameworks, and offers BAAs for HIPAA on Boost/Scale/Enterprise tiers.

recent_move.description: Closed a $75 million Series E led by Peak XV Partners at a $1.4 billion valuation in September 2025, achieving unicorn status and bringing total disclosed funding to $194 million across 7 rounds.

Closed a $70 million Series D led by Stripe at a $920 million valuation in June 2024, reportedly prompted by a positive tweet from Stripe CEO Patrick Collison, with participation from GV, Y Combinator, and Formus Capital.

Partnered with Lenny's Newsletter in December 2025 to offer annual subscribers a full year of PostHog Scale plus double free-tier credits (valued at $16,500, total Product Pass value over $25,000) — PostHog's first distribution partnership of this kind.

Expanded the product surface in 2024–2025 with PostHog Web Analytics, Mobile Session Replay, a managed Data Warehouse, the HogVM/Hog language runtime, AI Observability for LLM applications, and a PostHog AI copilot, extending the consolidated "Product OS" thesis into AI/observability territory.
Launched EU Cloud region on AWS eu-central-1 (Frankfurt, Germany) alongside the existing US-East-1 (Virginia) region to support EU data residency, GDPR compliance, and PostHog GmbH entity operations.

Disclosed and publicly post-mortemed the November 24, 2025 Shai-Hulud 2.0 npm supply chain attack that compromised PostHog's JavaScript SDKs, rotated credentials, fixed the underlying GitHub Actions workflow vulnerability, and added enhanced security practices — a defensive response covering 25,000+ affected developers.

expansion_highlight.description: PostHog launched EU Cloud on AWS Frankfurt (eu-central-1) and operates PostHog GmbH plus UK subsidiary Hiberly Ltd., indicating a deliberate push into European mid-market and regulated buyers seeking data residency. Observed in 2024 with continued investment into 2025.

HIPAA-compliant Cloud with BAA on Boost/Scale/Enterprise plus a BAA generator explicitly opens healthcare providers, health apps, and wearables as a new vertical, with documented PHI-safe deployment paths (data anonymization or self-hosting).

AI Observability for LLM applications and a PostHog AI copilot (built on OpenAI-style models) launched in 2025, targeting AI/LLM application builders as a new persona inside the existing developer base and broadening PostHog from traditional product analytics into AI tooling.

December 2025 Lenny's Newsletter Product Pass (one year of PostHog Scale plus double free-tier credits, $16,500 value) is PostHog's first major newsletter-distribution partnership, opening a new channel into the product management and senior engineering audience at scale.

Integration into Stripe Projects CLI alongside Vercel, Railway, Supabase, Neon, PlanetScale, Turso, Chroma, Clerk, and RunloopAI in 2026 developer preview extends PostHog into one-click developer-stack assembly, deepening ecosystem distribution.

$75M Series E in September 2025 led by Peak XV Partners and additional disclosed holding from Sofina in 2H 2025 add fresh primary capital and a strategic-angel footprint (PostHog CEO participated in Mem0's $24M round), signaling continued capacity to fund product and geographic expansion.
